introduction: Bring the forest evidence for temple access, then choose the separate sunbeam and mystical-rock returns. Inner keys, custom services and outside recipes form distinct progression leads.
orientation: Start with Trentloss at the forest gateway. Ask key, temple or lock. He accepts one exact heart of the pine and one exact mind of the bear together and grants a vine key. These are two different materials; two hearts do not replace the bear mind.

The pine spirit in the heart of the pine and the deranged bear in its alcove are the native evidence sources. Their passages begin hidden and closed. Successful SEARCH, opening, defeating a source and recovering its item are separate actions; supplied exact materials can also prepare the return.

The vine key fits the locked temple entrance. Obtaining the key, using it, opening the doorway and entering are separate events. A key supplied by another player or a door already opened by someone else can permit travel without recording your own exchange or door action.

The vine key and the two inner-temple keys are designed to break on use and have no-rent flags. Actual destruction, persistence and reset state matter. A recorded key exchange remains history after the key is spent; it does not guarantee that the entrance stays open.

Rantah in the cellar carries a shiny key for the hidden locked route up to the stairwell. The golden statue there carries a bright key for the locked dome above. Find the actual passage, obtain the matching key and use the live door state; finishing a quest does not automatically perform these actions.

The enraged demon in the dome carries two different materials: a sunbeam and a mystical rock. The sunbeam prepares the oak spirit return; the rock prepares Grentkas's return. Carrying one does not prepare both. Defeating the demon and recovering each item are separate from either accepted exchange.

Ask the spirit in the heart of the oak temple. One exact sunbeam earns the ring of the morning sun. The dialogue describes restoring the woods and promises a mace, while the actual reward is a ring. The accepted return records that exchange; it does not confirm a lasting forest restoration.

Ask Grentkas hi, hello, hey, howdy, item, items or craft in the guest rooms. One exact mystical rock earns an enchanted ring of stone. The native acceptance text refers to centaur armor; the actual item is a ring with finger and tail wear. These seven aliases lead to one conversation and one return.

Present each requested item loose and visible. Held equipment, items inside bags, similarly named objects and the creatures themselves do not replace the exact materials. Current preparation stays separate from accepted history and personal recovery, including when another player supplies a valid item.

Frolikk is an Epic Charisma teacher and carries a golden lyre and a unique music box. His epic teaching purchase is currently unavailable while economic accounting is active. Meeting him or owning an instrument does not record training, playing music or completing another native exchange.

A magical fountain lies in the stairwell and an epic stone in the dome. Their spell and reward services have their own eligibility and actual outcomes. A drink or touch attempt, a pending message or seeing someone else use them does not complete one of these three quest cards.

Pelakra and the research assistants supply scholarly lore and a tome. Llentor and the garden farmers provide exploration context. Farm belts and plant descriptions do not establish an additional magical garden barrier or a player harvesting requirement.

Garden ingredients support separate outside cooking and alchemy recipes. Grentkas's stone ring is also one material in Enfil's outside request, along with two other distinct items. These are optional leads with their own givers and receipts; owning an ingredient or a local reward does not finish an outside quest.

All three accepting givers remain after a successful return. Each exchange has its own achievement and potential daily. A day rollover does not replenish world stock or reopen doors. Repeated keywords create no separate achievements. New discovery, encounter, journal, achievement and daily credit requires active, ready accounting.

contacts.name: Rantah
contacts.description: Rantah in the cellar carries the shiny stairwell key. Current key access is separate from receiving a quest reward or recording your own unlocking.

contacts.name: a golden statue
contacts.description: The golden statue in the stairwell carries the bright dome key. Its source, actual recovery and live keyed access are separate progression concerns.

contacts.name: Frolikk

contacts.name: Pelakra

contacts.name: Llentor

contacts.name: a farmer
